question: marine sanitation device vessels 65 feet and under
expected_answer: A Type I, II, or III MSD.
source_quote: Vessels 65 feet and under may use a Type I, II, or III MSD.

question: horizontal bands spaced
expected_answer: Not more than 4 feet (1.2 m) apart.
source_quote: Horizontal bands must be spaced at intervals not more than 4 feet (1.2 m) apart measured from centerline to centerline.

question: stairways installed degrees from the horizontal
expected_answer: At least 30 degrees and no more than 50 degrees.
source_quote: Stairways must be installed at least 30 degrees —and no more than 50 degrees—from the horizontal.

question: vessel aground strokes on the bell International

question: buoys marking wrecks placed side
expected_answer: On the seaward or channelward side.
source_quote: Buoys marking wrecks or other obstructions are usually placed on the seaward or channelward side and not directly over a wreck.
